zh-Hant.title: 把活動通知變成待辦
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一項有期限的待辦，以及一句可以傳給朋友的提醒。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構教學通知 A1
活動日期：2026/11/21。
請於2026/11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆是否參加。
集合地點尚未公布。
zh-Hant.prompt: 將下方通知整理成一項待辦：要做什麼、何時以前完成。另列還沒公布的資訊。
steps: 另開分頁，進入你平常使用的 AI 工具並登入。教材留在原分頁，方便回來複製。
複製下方「練習資料」與「給AI要求」，一起貼進AI對話並送出。
讀完回答，再送出：「改成一句可以傳給朋友的提醒，語氣親切一點。」
看看短句有沒有留下11/18 18:00的回覆期限；喜歡的版本可複製到筆記，或用本頁的紀錄區保存。
zh-Hant.expected: 回覆期限仍是11/18 18:00，活動日是11/21。親切版可以是：「記得在11/18傍晚6點前回覆要不要參加11/21的活動喔！集合地點等主辦公布。」

independent.task: 新資料（虛構）A2：2026/12/03讀書活動；12/01 12:00（Asia/Taipei）前選一個主題；教室未定。另開新對話，寫待辦及未知，保存為第二份紀錄。
independent.expected: 12/01 12:00前選一個主題；來源A2；教室待確認；活動日12/03。需實際保存並重開，只有看答案不算操作完成。

challenge.task: 把資料改成給同伴看的兩句話，保留期限與未知。
challenge.source: 虛構A3：2026/12/05分享會；12/02 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前繳交題目；每人分享5分鐘；場地未定。
challenge.prompt: 將A3改成兩句話：第一句寫需完成的事與期限，第二句寫活動日、分享時間及未知。
challenge.expected: 請於2026/12/02 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前繳交題目。分享會在12/05，每人5分鐘，場地待確認。

checks: 短版仍有要做的事，沒有自行加上集合地點。

quiz.question: A1的回覆期限是哪個？

zh-Hant.outcome:
11/18 18:00前回覆是否參加。
11/21活動；集合地點等主辦公布。
zh-Hant.why: 收到活動、借書或報名通知時，先知道自己接下來要做什麼。

en.title: Turn an invitation into a to-do
en.goal: Get a dated to-do and a short reminder you can send to a friend.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional teaching notice A1
Activity date: 2026/11/21.
Reply whether you will attend by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei).
The meeting location has not been announced.
en.prompt: Turn this notice into one to-do: what to do and by when. List any details that have not been announced.
steps: Open your usual AI tool in another browser tab and sign in. Keep this lesson open so you can return to it.
Copy the practice text and request below, paste both into the AI chat, and send them.
Read the answer, then send: “Make this one friendly reminder I can send to a friend.”
Check that the shorter version keeps the 11/18 18:00 reply deadline. Copy your favorite version to notes or save it in this lesson’s record area.
en.expected: The reply deadline remains 11/18 18:00; the activity is on 11/21. A friendly version: “Remember to reply by 6 pm on 11/18 about joining the 11/21 activity! We’re waiting for the organizer to announce the meeting location.”

independent.task: New fictional source A2: reading activity on 2026/12/03; choose a topic by 12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei); classroom undecided. In a new chat, write the action and unknown, and save a second record.
independent.expected: Choose a topic by 12/01 12:00; source A2; classroom to confirm; activity on 12/03. Actually save and reopen it; reading this answer alone is not hands-on completion.

challenge.task: Make a two-sentence note for a partner, preserving the deadline and unknown.
challenge.source: Fictional A3: sharing session on 2026/12/05; submit a topic by 12/02 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); 5 minutes per speaker; venue undecided.
challenge.prompt: Rewrite A3 in two sentences. Put the action and deadline in the first; put the activity date, speaking time, and unknown in the second.
challenge.expected: Submit your topic by 2026/12/02 17:00 (Asia/Taipei). The session is on 12/05, with 5 minutes per speaker; the venue is to be confirmed.

checks: The reply deadline is 11/18 18:00, not the activity date of 11/21.
The short version keeps the action and does not invent a meeting location.

quiz.question: What is A1's reply deadline?
quiz.explanation: A1 explicitly says 11/18 18:00. The activity date, 11/21, is a different field.

en.outcome:
Reply by 11/18 18:00 about attending.
Activity: 11/21; meeting location to be announced.
en.why: When you receive an invitation or sign-up notice, find the next thing you need to do.

zh-Hant.title: 事情改了，請 AI 幫你更新
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一份只更新下載期限、保留原集合安排的提醒。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source: 虛構B0，時間Asia/Taipei：2026/11/19 20:00前下載車票；2026/11/21 09:00在雲岸車站集合；入住時間未提供。
zh-Hant.prompt: 把這段出發資訊整理成三行：下載車票、集合、入住。沒提供的就寫「待確認」。
steps: 把下方資料與要求一起貼到 AI，先取得三行提醒。
將「第二輪追問」的資料與要求貼到同一段對話，告訴 AI 下載期限改成19:00。
比較兩版：下載期限應提早一小時，集合時間仍是09:00。
留下你要使用的新版本；想更順手，可以再要求改成勾選清單。
zh-Hant.expected: 第一版下載期限11/19 20:00；更新後為19:00。集合仍是11/21 09:00雲岸車站，入住待確認。

independent.task: 新資料（虛構）R0：2026/12/04 16:00前交報告；12/06 10:00討論；會議室未定。R1：負責人確認交報告改15:00，其餘不變。時間Asia/Taipei。請自行製作三欄前後對照。

challenge.task: 整理衝突，不自行選一個期限。
challenge.source: 虛構C1：窗口甲說2026/11/19 19:00前下載。C2：窗口乙說同日18:30前下載。兩者都未說取代哪份通知，也未指定誰有決定權。時間Asia/Taipei。
challenge.prompt: 列出C1、C2的衝突、共同資訊及需要向誰確認；不要以較早或較新當作已確認答案。
challenge.expected: 共同：兩份下載期限都在2026/11/19；確切時間待確認。衝突：19:00與18:30相差30分鐘；有效截止時間待確認。向主辦決策窗口確認哪份有效及是否取代另一份；不能聲稱18:30已被正式採用。

checks: 下載期限從20:00改為19:00，提早一小時。
集合仍是11/21 09:00；入住時間仍待確認。

quiz.question: 套用第二輪的下載期限更新後，入住時間應寫什麼？
quiz.explanation: 兩個時間各有用途，不能用來補猜入住時間。

followup.source: 更新：主辦把下載車票期限改為2026/11/19 19:00（Asia/Taipei），其餘不變。
followup.prompt: 請更新剛才的三行提醒，只把下載期限改成19:00。

zh-Hant.why: 時間、地點或人數臨時改變時，不用把整份內容重新寫一遍。

en.title: Plans changed: ask AI to update them
en.goal: Get a reminder with an updated ticket deadline and the original meeting details.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source: Fictional B0; time zone Asia/Taipei: download tickets by 2026/11/19 20:00; meet at Cloudbank Station on 2026/11/21 at 09:00; check-in time not provided.
en.prompt: Organize these departure details into three lines: ticket download, meeting, and check-in. Write “to confirm” for anything not provided.
steps: Paste the data and request below into AI to get your three-line reminder.
Paste the second-round data and request into the same chat to change the download deadline to 19:00.
Compare the versions: download is one hour earlier, while the meeting stays at 09:00.
Save the updated version you want to use. You can also ask to turn it into a checklist.
en.expected: The first version has a download deadline of 11/19 20:00; the update changes it to 19:00. Meeting remains 11/21 09:00 at Cloudbank Station; check-in is to confirm.

independent.task: New fictional R0: report due 2026/12/04 16:00; discussion 12/06 10:00; room undecided. R1: the owner confirms the report deadline changes to 15:00; everything else stays the same. Time zone Asia/Taipei. Make a before/after comparison yourself.
independent.expected: Report deadline 12/04 16:00 → 15:00, 1 hour earlier; discussion remains 12/06 10:00; room remains to confirm.

challenge.task: Identify the conflict without choosing an unsupported deadline.
challenge.source: Fictional C1: contact A says download by 2026/11/19 19:00. C2: contact B says 18:30 the same day. Neither states which notice is replaced or who has authority. Time zone Asia/Taipei.
challenge.prompt: List the conflict, common facts, and who should confirm the answer. Do not treat earlier or newer as a confirmed answer.
challenge.expected: Shared fact: download is due on 2026/11/19. Conflict: 19:00 versus 18:30, a 30-minute difference; the valid deadline is unconfirmed. Ask the organizer's decision owner which notice is valid and whether it replaces the other. Do not claim 18:30 is officially adopted.

checks: The download deadline moves from 20:00 to 19:00, one hour earlier.
Meeting remains 11/21 09:00; check-in remains to confirm.

quiz.question: After the second-round ticket-deadline update, what is the check-in time?
choices: To confirm; the source does not provide it
quiz.explanation: Those times refer to different actions and cannot fill the missing check-in time.

followup.source: Update: the organizer changes the ticket download deadline to 2026/11/19 19:00 (Asia/Taipei). Everything else stays the same.
followup.prompt: Update the three-line reminder, changing only the download deadline to 19:00.
followup.expected: Download tickets by 11/19 19:00. Meet on 11/21 at 09:00 at Cloudbank Station. Check-in: to confirm.

en.outcome:
Download tickets by 11/19 19:00.
Meet on 11/21 at 09:00 at Cloudbank Station.
en.why: When a time, location, or headcount changes, you do not have to rewrite everything.

zh-Hant.title: 把零散訊息整理成一份安排
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一份把確定安排與待詢問事項分開的行程表。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構資料，時間Asia/Taipei。
D｜10/20發布：2026/11/21 10:00雲岸車站集合。
B｜10/25主辦核准：取代D；2026/11/21 09:00雲岸車站集合；11/19 19:00前下載車票；入住未定。
E｜10/28討論草稿：建議11/21 08:30集合，尚未核准。
F｜接駁筆記：11/21 09:30發車；未註明核准狀態。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請把四則訊息整理成「要做的事／時間／備註」表格。主辦已確認的安排放前面，建議或還要問的事放後面。
steps: 把四則訊息與要求一起貼到 AI，取得第一版表格。
回頭看主辦訊息B：集合是09:00，E的08:30仍是建議。看看表格有沒有分開。
接著送出：「改成出門前看的三行提醒，最後列一個要問主辦的問題。」
讀讀短版，確認你一眼能找到集合時間與下載期限，再保存想用的版本。
zh-Hant.expected: 目前集合是11/21 09:00雲岸車站，11/19 19:00前下載車票。08:30只是草稿建議；09:30接駁是否確定、入住時間都可以再問主辦。

independent.task: 虛構P：10/26核准，報名上限20人。Q：10/29草稿，建議30人，未核准。R：10/28窗口留言『上限25人』，未說是否取代P。請列目前核准值與未解事項。
independent.expected: 已知核准值20人（P）；30人是草稿；25人留言與P不同但權限／取代關係不明，需向決策者確認，不能宣稱最後有效上限必為25或30。

challenge.task: 在沒有目前核准版的情況下，保留不確定。
challenge.prompt: 今天可以確認費用是多少嗎？列出兩份資料的限制與需要的證據。
challenge.expected: 無法確認當前費用。V1已過期；V2較新但未核准。需取得當前核准的費用通知、適用日期及發布者確認；不能選300或350作為已確認值。

checks: 集合採用主辦確認的09:00；08:30仍是建議。
09:30是接駁發車筆記，不能當成集合時間。

quiz.question: 為什麼本題採用B的09:00？
choices: 任何較新的文件都有效
quiz.explanation: 採用理由是核准與取代關係；更新日期本身不充分。

zh-Hant.outcome:
集合：11/21 09:00，雲岸車站。
車票：11/19 19:00前下載；接駁時間再問主辦。
zh-Hant.why: 群組裡有人改時間、有人提建議時，讓 AI 幫你找出目前要照做的安排。

en.title: Bring scattered messages into one plan
en.goal: Get a schedule that separates confirmed plans from questions to ask.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional data; time zone Asia/Taipei.
D | issued 10/20: meet at Cloudbank Station on 2026/11/21 at 10:00.
B | organizer approved 10/25: replaces D; meet at Cloudbank Station on 2026/11/21 at 09:00; download tickets by 11/19 19:00; check-in undecided.
E | discussion draft 10/28: suggests meeting on 11/21 at 08:30; not approved.
F | shuttle note: departs 11/21 at 09:30; approval status not stated.
en.prompt: Turn these four messages into a table: action / time / note. Put organizer-confirmed arrangements first, then suggestions and questions.
steps: Paste the four messages and request into AI to get a table.
Look back at organizer message B: the meeting is 09:00; E’s 08:30 is a suggestion. Check that the table keeps them separate.
Then send: “Make this three lines I can read before leaving, followed by one question for the organizer.”
Check that you can quickly find the meeting time and ticket deadline, then save your preferred version.
en.expected: Meet on 11/21 at 09:00 at Cloudbank Station; download tickets by 11/19 19:00. 08:30 is only a draft suggestion. You can ask the organizer about the 09:30 shuttle and check-in time.

independent.task: Fictional P: approved 10/26, registration limit 20 people. Q: draft 10/29 suggests 30, unapproved. R: contact message 10/28 says 'limit 25' without stating whether it replaces P. List the approved value and unresolved issues.
independent.expected: Known approved value: 20 (P). The 30-person value is a draft. The 25-person message differs from P, but authority and replacement are unclear. Ask the decision owner; do not assert that 25 or 30 is the final valid limit.

challenge.task: Preserve uncertainty when no current approved version is available.
challenge.source: Fictional V1: valid through 2026/10/20; fee 300 TWD. V2: draft dated 2026/10/28; proposed fee 350 TWD, unapproved. Inquiry date: 2026/10/29.
challenge.prompt: Can today's fee be confirmed? State the limitations of both documents and the evidence needed.
challenge.expected: The current fee cannot be confirmed. V1 expired; V2 is newer but unapproved. Obtain the current approved fee notice, effective dates, and publisher confirmation. Neither 300 nor 350 can be presented as confirmed.

checks: Use the organizer-confirmed 09:00 meeting; 08:30 remains a suggestion.
09:30 is a shuttle departure note, not the meeting time.

quiz.question: Why use B's 09:00 in this exercise?
choices: B is approved and explicitly replaces D
quiz.explanation: Approval and replacement support the choice. A newer date alone is insufficient.

en.outcome:
Meet: 11/21 09:00, Cloudbank Station.
Tickets: download by 11/19 19:00; ask about the shuttle.
en.why: When a group chat mixes changes and suggestions, ask AI to pull out the arrangements to follow.

zh-Hant.title: Gmail：讀懂一封信，寫好回覆
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一封表達參加意願、詢問集合地點的回覆草稿。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構練習郵件
主旨：雲岸活動確認
您好！請於2026/11/18 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆是否參加11/21的活動。集合地點稍後公布。
你的決定：會參加，希望先詢問集合地點。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請整理這封信需要我做的事，並替我寫三句禮貌回覆：我會參加，也想詢問集合地點。先給我文字草稿。
steps: 把下方郵件文字與要求一起貼到 AI；這一步不需要 Gmail 帳號連線。
讀一遍草稿，看看有沒有表達「會參加」與詢問集合地點。
接著送出：「改得更親切，縮成兩句，不用太正式。」
挑選你喜歡的版本保存。這是供你使用的回覆文字，尚未寄出；想練真正讀信再展開進階連線。
zh-Hant.expected: 待辦：2026/11/18 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆是否參加。第一輪三句版：「您好，我會參加11/21的活動！請問集合地點什麼時候會公布？謝謝。」第二輪兩句版：「您好，我會參加11/21的活動！請問集合地點什麼時候會公布，謝謝。」兩版都表達會參加並詢問集合地點；縮短後仍保留原意，草稿尚未寄出。

independent.task: 試試另一封虛構郵件：「請於11/05 12:00前確認是否來領書，領取地點稍後通知。」你的決定是可以領取。自己寫一句要求，請AI協助回覆。
independent.expected: 例如：「您好，我可以來領書，請再告訴我領取地點，謝謝！」並記得在11/05 12:00前回覆。

challenge.task: 把部分回覆與改期分開處理。
challenge.source: 虛構同一信串：J1主辦說2026/11/07 09:00集合，需回覆參加及餐點。J2主辦更正集合為10:00、其餘不變。J3學員只回覆『會參加』。餐點尚未回覆。時間Asia/Taipei。
challenge.prompt: 列目前安排、已完成回覆與仍待回覆，草擬不猜餐點的追問。
challenge.expected: 集合11/07 10:00（J2）；參加已回覆（J3）；餐點未回覆。不能把參加回覆當成全部完成。可問學員『你要選什麼餐點？』；未取得選擇前不代填、不寄出。

checks: 回覆清楚表達會參加，並詢問集合地點。
第二輪回覆是兩句，仍表達會參加並詢問集合地點；草稿尚未寄出。

quiz.question: 你想讓回覆自然一點，可以怎麼追問？
choices: 改成像平常傳訊息的語氣，保留我要表達的兩件事
不用讀草稿就直接寄出
quiz.explanation: 告訴AI想改的語氣，同時保留你原本要表達的內容。

zh-Hant.outcome:
您好，我會參加11/21的活動！
請問集合地點什麼時候會公布？謝謝。
zh-Hant.why: 遇到邀請、確認或詢問信時，先抓重點，再用自己的口氣回覆。

connection.title: 進階選做：請 AI 讀你指定的一封 Gmail
connection.source: 準備一封你有權使用、沒有個資或機密的練習信。可以在自己的練習帳號寄一封範例給自己，主旨自訂為「AI練習－活動確認」，內文用本課虛構郵件；記下實際寄信日期。
connection.prompt: 請用Gmail讀取我指定的這封練習信：主旨【填入完整主旨】，寄信日期【填入實際日期】。若找到多封，先列出讓我選。讀取後整理待辦並寫回覆草稿，只放在對話，不寄出、不建立Gmail草稿。
steps: 在你使用的AI工具找可用的Plugins／外掛或連接應用程式，搜尋Gmail，依畫面連接你要用的練習帳號並查看授權範圍。是否支援取決於工具、方案與工作區。
把下方要求中的主旨與日期換成你的資料；在對話選用Gmail外掛，再送出要求。
打開AI提供的原信連結，確認它讀的是那一封；再看回覆草稿是否符合你的意思。
若無此服務或讀不到信，就回到貼文字練習；不要把整理文字誤當成已連線。
connection.expected: 你能開到指定原信，AI讀過內容並在對話寫出草稿。信尚未寄出。

en.title: Gmail: understand a message and draft a reply
en.goal: Get a reply draft that confirms attendance and asks about the location.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional practice email
Subject: Cloudbank activity confirmation
Hello! Please reply by 2026/11/18 17:00 (Asia/Taipei) to say whether you will attend the activity on 11/21. The meeting location will be announced later.
Your decision: you will attend and would like to ask about the location.
en.prompt: List what I need to do in this email, then write a polite three-sentence reply: I will attend and would like to ask about the meeting location. Give me a text draft first.
steps: Paste the sample email and request into AI. This step does not need a Gmail connection.
Read the draft and check that it says you will attend and asks about the location.
Then send: “Make it friendlier and just two sentences, without sounding too formal.”
Save the version you like. This reply text has not been sent. Open the optional connection exercise to practice reading a real message.
en.expected: Action: reply by 2026/11/18 17:00 (Asia/Taipei). First-round three-sentence draft: “Hello, I’ll be attending on 11/21! When will the meeting location be announced? Thank you.” Second-round two-sentence draft: “Hello, I’ll be attending on 11/21! Could you let me know when the meeting location will be announced, please?” Both confirm attendance and ask about the location. Shortening preserves the meaning; neither draft has been sent.

independent.task: Try a different fictional email: “Please confirm by 11/05 12:00 whether you can collect your books. We will send the pickup location later.” You can collect them. Write your own short request for help replying.
independent.expected: For example: “Hello, I can collect the books. Please let me know the pickup location. Thank you!” Remember to reply by 11/05 12:00.

challenge.task: Separate a partial reply from a schedule update.
challenge.source: Fictional thread: J1 organizer says meet 2026/11/07 09:00 and asks for attendance and meal choice. J2 organizer changes meeting to 10:00; all else unchanged. J3 learner replies only 'I will attend.' Meal choice remains unanswered. Time zone Asia/Taipei.
challenge.prompt: List the current arrangement, completed reply, and remaining reply. Draft a question without guessing the meal choice.
challenge.expected: Meet 11/07 10:00 (J2); attendance answered (J3); meal unanswered. Attendance alone does not complete everything. Ask the learner 'Which meal would you like?' Do not fill in or send a choice before receiving it.

checks: The reply says you will attend and asks about the meeting location.
The activity is 11/21; the reply is due by 11/18 17:00.
The second-round reply has two sentences, still confirms attendance, and asks about the location; it has not been sent.

quiz.question: How can you ask for a more natural reply?
choices: Use an everyday messaging tone while keeping my two main points
Send it without reading the draft
quiz.explanation: Describe the tone you want while keeping your original meaning.

en.outcome:
Hello, I’ll be attending on 11/21!
When will the meeting location be announced? Thank you.
en.why: For invitations, confirmations, or questions, pull out the key point and reply in your own voice.

connection.title: Optional: ask AI to read one Gmail message you choose
connection.source: Prepare a practice message you may use, with no personal or confidential information. You can send the fictional email to yourself in a practice account, using a distinctive subject such as “AI practice – activity confirmation.” Note the actual sending date.
connection.prompt: Use Gmail to read this practice email: subject [enter the exact subject], sending date [enter the actual date]. If several match, list them for me to choose. Read it, summarize my action, and write a reply in this chat only. Do not send it or create a Gmail draft.
steps: Look for available Plugins or connected apps in your AI tool, find Gmail, and follow the connection flow for your practice account. Review the requested access. Availability depends on the tool, plan, and workspace.
Replace the subject and date in the request with your details. Select the Gmail plugin in the conversation and send the request.
Open the original-message link AI returns to check that it read the intended email, then review the reply.
If the service is unavailable or cannot read the email, return to pasted-text practice. Text organization alone does not establish a connection.
connection.expected: You can open the specified original message, and AI has read its content and produced a chat draft. The email has not been sent.

zh-Hant.title: Google Drive：把兩個方案放在一起比較
zh-Hant.goal: 得到兩個四人方案的費用比較表，以及給同行朋友的短說明。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構出遊方案：同一天、4人、金額都是TWD。
方案A：交通每人600；四人住宿共2400；含早餐。
方案B：交通四人共2200；四人住宿共2600；早餐另計，價格還沒提供。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請把方案A和B整理成四人費用比較表，列交通、住宿、早餐及已知小計。每人價要乘以4；沒寫的費用請留「待確認」。
steps: 把下方兩段資料與要求一起貼到 AI，先看比較表。
看A的交通是否算成600×4，再看B的早餐是否留待確認。
接著送出：「改成三句給同行朋友看的說明，說明兩案差在哪裡。」
保留比較表或短版，想直接讀自己的 Drive 文件，再試進階連線。
zh-Hant.expected: A：交通2400、住宿2400，含早餐，合計4800 TWD。B：交通2200、住宿2600，已知小計4800 TWD，還要加早餐。給朋友的說法可以是：「兩案目前列出的費用都是4800元。A已含早餐，B的早餐另計。我們可以先問B早餐多少錢，再決定。」

independent.task: 新虛構文件C：2人，TWD，每人票價350，雙人房1800，含早餐。D：2人票共600，雙人房1900，含早餐。同為2026/12/01且本題比較範圍僅票、房、早餐。請自行比較並標示來源。
independent.expected: C：350×2+1800=2500；D：600+1900=2500 TWD；同口徑合計相同。不能從此推論服務品質相同。

challenge.task: 處理不同人數與幣別，不假造換算。
challenge.source: 虛構方案E：2026/11/21，3人，總價150 USD，含交通與住宿，早餐未說明。方案F：同日4人，總價4800 TWD，含交通、住宿、早餐。沒有匯率。
challenge.prompt: 列能算的數字、不能比較的原因與需補資訊；不要查外部匯率或推薦方案。
challenge.expected: E每人50 USD；F每人1200 TWD。人數、幣別與早餐包含範圍不同，無法直接判斷高低；需同人數報價、約定匯率及日期、早餐費與包含條件。

checks: A交通是600×4＝2400；B交通2200已是四人價。
兩案已知小計都是4800 TWD，B還要加早餐。

quiz.question: B的4800 TWD代表什麼？
choices: 已知小計，早餐費仍未知
含所有項目的完整總額
quiz.explanation: 4800只包含來源已提供的交通與住宿。

zh-Hant.outcome:
方案A：4800 TWD，含早餐。
方案B：已知4800 TWD，早餐另計。
zh-Hant.why: 文件分散在不同地方時，請 AI 摘出同一組欄位，較容易看出差別。

connection.title: 進階選做：讀取自己的 Drive 練習文件
connection.source: 在自己的Google Drive建立兩份空白Google文件，分別命名為「AI練習－方案A」「AI練習－方案B」。把本課A、B各自的虛構資料貼入對應文件，取得兩份文件連結。
connection.prompt: 請用Google Drive讀取這兩份練習文件：【A連結】、【B連結】。依內文比較四人交通、住宿、早餐與已知小計，給我一張表；不要修改文件。若無法讀到內文，請直接告訴我。
steps: 先自己打開兩份文件，確認內文已存好且帳號有讀取權限。
在AI工具可用的Plugins／外掛或連接應用程式中連接Google Drive，確認使用的是有權限的帳號。
將兩個連結填入下方要求，選用Drive外掛後送出。
回兩份原文件看看數字與比較表是否一致。讀取不成功時，用主練習的貼文字方式繼續。
connection.expected: AI從你指定的兩份文件讀到價格，整理出A共4800、B已知4800另加早餐的比較表，沒有修改原文件。

en.title: Google Drive: compare two options side by side
en.goal: Get a comparison table for two four-person options and a short explanation for companions.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional trip options for the same day, 4 people, all prices in TWD.
A: transport 600 per person; accommodation 2400 for four; breakfast included.
B: transport 2200 for four; accommodation 2600 for four; breakfast extra, price not yet provided.
en.prompt: Make a four-person cost table for A and B: transport, accommodation, breakfast, and known subtotal. Multiply per-person prices by 4; mark missing prices “to confirm.”
steps: Paste both excerpts and the request into AI to get a comparison table.
Check that A’s transport is 600×4 and B’s breakfast is still to confirm.
Then send: “Explain the differences in three sentences for my travel companions.”
Save the table or short explanation. Try the optional connection exercise to read your own Drive documents directly.
en.expected: A: transport 2400 + accommodation 2400 = 4800 TWD including breakfast. B: transport 2200 + accommodation 2600 = known subtotal 4800 TWD, plus breakfast. A short explanation: “Both currently list 4800 TWD. A includes breakfast, but B charges extra. Let’s ask about B’s breakfast price before deciding.”

independent.task: New fictional file C: 2 people, TWD, tickets 350 per person, double room 1800, breakfast included. D: tickets 600 for two, double room 1900, breakfast included. Both for 2026/12/01; comparison scope is tickets, room, and breakfast only. Compare independently and cite the sources.
independent.expected: C: 350×2+1800=2500. D: 600+1900=2500 TWD. Totals match under the same scope; this does not establish equal service quality.

challenge.task: Handle different group sizes and currencies without inventing a conversion.
challenge.source: Fictional option E: 2026/11/21, 3 people, 150 USD total, transport and lodging included, breakfast unspecified. F: same date, 4 people, 4800 TWD total, transport, lodging, and breakfast included. No exchange rate is supplied.
challenge.prompt: State what can be calculated, why direct comparison is invalid, and what information is missing. Do not fetch an external exchange rate or recommend an option.
challenge.expected: E is 50 USD per person; F is 1200 TWD per person. Group size, currency, and breakfast coverage differ, so a price ranking is unsupported. Obtain quotes for the same group size, an agreed exchange rate and date, and breakfast costs and inclusion terms.

checks: A’s transport is 600×4 = 2400; B’s 2200 already covers four people.
Both known subtotals are 4800 TWD; B still needs breakfast added.

quiz.question: What does B's 4800 TWD represent?
choices: A known subtotal; breakfast cost is still unknown
quiz.explanation: 4800 includes only the supplied transport and lodging costs.

en.outcome:
A: 4800 TWD, breakfast included.
B: known subtotal 4800 TWD, plus breakfast.
en.why: When information sits in separate documents, ask AI to extract the same fields so differences are easier to see.

connection.title: Optional: read your own Drive practice documents
connection.source: Create two blank Google Docs in your Drive named “AI practice – option A” and “AI practice – option B.” Paste each option’s fictional data into its matching document and copy both links.
connection.prompt: Use Google Drive to read these practice documents: [A link], [B link]. Compare transport, accommodation, breakfast, and known subtotal for four people in a table. Do not edit the documents. If you cannot read their contents, tell me.
steps: Open both documents yourself to confirm their text is saved and your account can read them.
Connect Google Drive through available Plugins or connected apps in your AI tool, using the account with access.
Put both links into the request, select the Drive plugin, and send it.
Compare the table with the original documents. If reading fails, continue with pasted text from the main exercise.
connection.expected: AI reads prices from your two specified documents and produces A at 4800 and B at a known 4800 plus breakfast, without changing the documents.

zh-Hant.title: Notion：把隨手筆記變成計畫
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一份列出事情、負責人與期限的讀書會待辦表。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構教學頁：[AI Lab] 讀書會起步 N1
活動：2026/11/21 14:00（Asia/Taipei），6人。
T01：小禾於11/18前選三篇文章，未完成。
T02：11/19前確認場地，負責人未定，未完成。
預算尚未決定。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請把這份筆記整理成活動資訊、待辦表、還要討論的事。待辦表列編號、事情、負責人、期限、進度；沒寫的先留「待確認」。
steps: 把下方筆記與要求一起貼到 AI，取得計畫草稿。
讀一遍待辦表，看看「選文章」與「確認場地」是不是分成兩項。
接著送出：「我來負責T02確認場地，請只更新這一項。」
把滿意的計畫複製到筆記保存。想放到真正的 Notion 頁面，再試進階連線。
zh-Hant.expected: 活動：11/21 14:00，6人。T01：小禾11/18前選三篇文章，未完成。T02：11/19前確認場地，未完成；追問後負責人改成「我」。還要討論：場地與預算。這份內容先留在AI對話裡，可自行複製到筆記。

independent.task: 新虛構筆記N2：2026/12/02 15:00（Asia/Taipei）分享會；T10阿青12/01前準備投影片，進行中；T11場地確認已完成，場地為雲樓A室；人數未知。先用貼文字完成三類草稿，不寫回。
independent.expected: 已確認12/02 15:00、雲樓A室、T11已完成；待辦T10阿青12/01前準備投影片，進行中；待確認人數。狀態是未寫回的草稿。

challenge.task: 模擬以識別碼更新與本週篩選，避免重複新增。
challenge.source: 虛構資料：本週2026/11/16–11/22。T01｜11/18｜小禾｜未完成；T02｜11/19｜負責人空白｜未完成；T03｜11/25｜阿青｜未完成。更新：T01改已完成；T02負責人仍未知。
challenge.prompt: 只模擬資料庫表格：依ID套用更新，列本週未完成。再次套用同一更新後列總列數。不要實際寫入Notion。
challenge.expected: 更新後共3列，T01已完成；本週未完成只顯示T02，負責人待確認。T03下週，不入本週篩選。重複同一更新仍3列，不新增第二個T01。這是文字模擬，未建立實際資料庫。

checks: 選文章與確認場地分成兩項，不混在一起。
追問後只有T02負責人改成「我」，期限仍11/19。
預算仍待討論，不能自行加上金額。

quiz.question: AI在對話列出計畫後，Notion頁是否已建立？
choices: 不能如此判定；需要實際寫入及目的頁驗證
quiz.explanation: 產生文字與寫入外部頁面是不同動作。

zh-Hant.outcome:
T01｜小禾｜11/18前選三篇文章。
T02｜我｜11/19前確認場地。
zh-Hant.why: 會議或聊天後的筆記很亂時，先整理成待辦，再放進你使用的筆記工具。

connection.title: 進階選做：把計畫放進自己的 Notion
connection.source: 在自己的Notion練習區建立一頁「AI練習－讀書會」，貼上本課虛構筆記並複製頁面連結。再建立一個空白父頁「AI練習－成果」，準備放整理後的版本。
connection.prompt: 請用Notion讀取這頁：【練習頁連結】。整理活動資訊與待辦表，先在對話給我看，不修改頁面。
steps: 在AI工具可用的Plugins／外掛或連接應用程式中連接Notion，依實際授權畫面允許使用你的練習頁；先自己確認頁面能開啟。
填入來源連結，選用Notion外掛送出下方要求，看看草稿是否符合筆記。
想真正存進Notion時，再送出：「請在【成果父頁連結】下建立『讀書會計畫』，寫入剛才這份完整草稿。」這一步才會新增頁面。
打開回傳的新頁連結，查看標題、待辦與放置位置。沒有寫入權限時，可自行把草稿複製到練習頁。
connection.expected: 讀取階段只有對話草稿；你另外要求寫入且成功後，才會有可開啟的新Notion頁面。

en.title: Notion: turn rough notes into a plan
en.goal: Get a reading-group action table with tasks, owners, and deadlines.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional teaching page: [AI Lab] Reading group start N1
Activity: 2026/11/21 14:00 (Asia/Taipei), 6 people.
T01: Xiaohe to choose three articles by 11/18, incomplete.
T02: confirm venue by 11/19, owner undecided, incomplete.
Budget undecided.
en.prompt: Organize these notes into activity details, an action table, and things to discuss. Use ID, task, owner, deadline, and progress as columns; mark missing details “to confirm.”
steps: Paste the notes and request into AI to get a draft plan.
Read the task table: choosing articles and confirming the venue should be separate tasks.
Then send: “I will take responsibility for T02, confirming the venue. Update only that item.”
Copy the plan you like into your notes. Try the optional connection exercise to put it in an actual Notion page.
en.expected: Activity: 11/21 14:00, 6 people. T01: Xiaohe chooses three articles by 11/18, incomplete. T02: confirm venue by 11/19, incomplete; after your follow-up its owner is “me.” Still to discuss: venue and budget. This stays in the AI chat until you copy it into your notes.

independent.task: New fictional N2: sharing session 2026/12/02 15:00 (Asia/Taipei); T10 Aqing prepares slides by 12/01, in progress; T11 venue confirmation completed, venue Cloud Tower room A; participant count unknown. Produce the three-part draft using pasted text; do not write it back.
independent.expected: Confirmed: 12/02 15:00, Cloud Tower room A, T11 completed. Action: T10 Aqing prepares slides by 12/01, in progress. Question: participant count. Status: draft, not written back.

challenge.task: Simulate ID-based updates and this-week filtering without creating duplicates.
challenge.source: Fictional data; this week is 2026/11/16–11/22. T01 | 11/18 | Xiaohe | incomplete; T02 | 11/19 | blank owner | incomplete; T03 | 11/25 | Aqing | incomplete. Update: T01 completed; T02 owner still unknown.
challenge.prompt: Simulate a database table only: apply updates by ID and list incomplete items this week. Apply the same update again and give the total row count. Do not write to Notion.
challenge.expected: There are 3 rows after updating, with T01 completed. Only T02 is incomplete this week; owner remains to confirm. T03 is next week and is excluded. Repeating the update leaves 3 rows, without a second T01. This is a text simulation, not a created database.

checks: Choosing articles and confirming the venue are separate tasks.
After the follow-up, only T02’s owner becomes “me”; its deadline stays 11/19.
The budget remains to discuss; no amount is invented.

quiz.question: After AI lists a plan in chat, has a Notion page been created?
choices: That is unproven; actual writing and destination verification are needed
A title alone proves it exists
quiz.explanation: Generating text and writing to an external page are different actions.

en.outcome:
T01 | Xiaohe | Choose three articles by 11/18.
T02 | Me | Confirm the venue by 11/19.
en.why: After a meeting or chat, organize rough notes into actions before putting them in your notes app.

connection.title: Optional: put the plan in your own Notion
connection.source: In your Notion practice area, create “AI practice – reading group,” paste this lesson’s fictional notes, and copy the page link. Create a separate blank parent page, “AI practice – results,” for the organized version.
connection.prompt: Use Notion to read this page: [practice page link]. Organize activity details and an action table. Show the draft in chat first without changing the page.
steps: Connect Notion through available Plugins or connected apps in your AI tool. Use the actual permission flow to allow your practice pages, and confirm you can open them yourself.
Insert the source-page link, select the Notion plugin, and send the request. Review the draft against your notes.
To save it to Notion, send a separate request: “Under [results parent link], create Reading group plan and write the complete draft we just reviewed.” This is the step that creates a page.
Open the returned page and check its title, tasks, and location. Without write access, copy the draft to your practice page yourself.
connection.expected: Reading produces a chat draft. An actual new Notion page exists only after you separately request writing and it succeeds.

zh-Hant.title: 表格：看看這個月多花在哪裡
zh-Hant.goal: 得到每月總額、各分類差異與一句看得懂的花費小結。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請用這六列算9月、10月總額、增加金額與百分比（小數1位），再列各分類多花多少。先找「增加超過50元」的分類。
steps: 把六列資料與要求一起貼到 AI，取得每月花費小結。
用計算機看看9月是否2100、10月是否2350，多250元。
接著送出：「把超過50元改成至少50元，哪些分類會列出來？」看結果從1類變成3類。
再試：「新增一筆10月餐食退款-100元，請重新計算。」10月應變2250元；保存你覺得最好懂的說明。

independent.task: 新虛構資料（TWD）：9月書籍300、交通200；10月書籍360、交通240。算兩月總額與增幅，再比較分類增加>40及>=40。

challenge.task: 同時處理缺值、零基期與不同幣別。
challenge.source: 虛構，逐分類比較：9月課程0 TWD、餐食100 TWD；10月課程200 TWD、餐食金額缺漏、書籍10 USD。沒有匯率；不能補猜金額。
challenge.prompt: 按幣別列已知小計、未知及能算的差額。課程百分比可算嗎？能宣稱10月完整總額或整體增幅嗎？
challenge.expected: 9月已知TWD合計100；10月已知TWD小計200，餐食未知，另有10 USD不能直接相加。課程差額+200，但基期0，百分比不適用。10月完整總額與整體增幅無法確認，不能用已知小計當完整總額。

checks: 超過50元只有餐食；至少50元則三類都符合。

quiz.question: 原六列改用『至少50』後，符合幾類？
quiz.explanation: 至少包含等於；150、50、50都符合。篩選門檻不改變原總額。

zh-Hant.why: 不必逐列找數字，請 AI 幫你彙整，再自己確認幾個重要加總。

en.title: Tables: where did this month’s money go?
en.goal: Get monthly totals, category differences, and a readable spending summary.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional spending; purchase-month basis; all TWD. Positive values are spending; negatives are refunds.
ID,Month,Category,Amount
S01,2026-09,Meals,1200
S02,2026-09,Transport,400
S03,2026-09,Services,500
O01,2026-10,Meals,1350
O02,2026-10,Transport,450
O03,2026-10,Services,550
en.prompt: Using these six rows, calculate September and October totals, the increase, and percentage increase to 1 decimal. Show the change in each category. First find categories with an increase greater than 50.
steps: Paste the six rows and request into AI to get a spending summary.
Use a calculator to check September 2100, October 2350, and an increase of 250.
Then send: “Change greater than 50 to at least 50. Which categories appear?” Watch the result change from 1 category to 3.
Try: “Add an October meals refund of -100 and recalculate.” October should become 2250. Save the explanation you find clearest.
en.expected: Original six rows: September 2100; October 2350; increase 250; 250÷2100×100≈11.9%. Categories: meals +150, transport +50, services +50. >50 selects meals only, 1 category; >=50 selects 3. Monthly totals do not change. After an October meals refund of -100: October 2250, increase 150, 150÷2100×100≈7.1%; net meals 1250, with all three categories +50.

independent.task: New fictional TWD data: September books 300, transport 200; October books 360, transport 240. Calculate monthly totals and percentage change, then compare category increases >40 and >=40.
independent.expected: September 500; October 600; increase 100, 20.0%. Books +60, transport +40. >40 selects 1 category; >=40 selects 2. Thresholds do not change totals.

challenge.task: Handle missing amounts, a zero baseline, and different currencies together.
challenge.source: Fictional category data: September courses 0 TWD, meals 100 TWD; October courses 200 TWD, meals amount missing, books 10 USD. No exchange rate; do not guess amounts.
challenge.prompt: List known subtotals by currency, unknowns, and valid differences. Can the courses percentage be calculated? Can a complete October total or overall percentage change be claimed?
challenge.expected: September known TWD total is 100. October known TWD subtotal is 200 with meals unknown; the separate 10 USD cannot be added directly. Courses increase by 200, but percentage change is undefined with a zero baseline. The complete October total and overall percentage change are unconfirmed; a known subtotal is not a complete total.

checks: The original totals are 2100 and 2350: an increase of 250, about 11.9%.
Greater than 50 selects meals; at least 50 selects all three categories.
After the -100 refund, October is 2250: up 150, about 7.1%.

quiz.question: How many original categories meet 'at least 50'?
quiz.explanation: At least includes equality, so 150, 50, and 50 all qualify. Filtering does not change the original totals.

en.outcome:
September 2100 → October 2350 TWD.
Up 250, about 11.9%; meals increased by 150.
en.why: Let AI group the numbers, then check a few important totals yourself.

zh-Hant.title: 請 AI 做一張可勾選的小網頁
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一個可下載、可開啟、能勾選與重設的清單網頁。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source: 虛構清單：標題『出發前檢查』；三項任務依序為『下載車票』『確認集合地點』『帶水壺』。本題不用網路、不保存進度；重新開啟時回到0/3。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請依下方三項任務做一個完整HTML清單，CSS與JavaScript放在同一檔，不用外部套件或網路。每項可勾選，顯示已完成n/3，附重設按鈕。手機與鍵盤都能操作。不要保存進度，重新開啟清為0/3，頁面也寫明這點。請給完整程式碼，不要省略。
steps: 把「練習資料」與「給AI要求」貼到自己的AI，取得完整HTML程式碼。
複製程式碼，貼到本頁「完整 HTML 程式碼」欄，不含開頭與結尾的三個反引號；按「更新隔離預覽」。
在預覽勾兩項、取消一項，再按重設：數字應依序是2/3、1/3、0/3。
按「下載這份 HTML」，從瀏覽器下載清單開啟檔案，看看重新開啟是否回到0/3。
回同一個AI對話送出：「只把帶水壺改成帶筆記本，給我完整新版HTML。」把新版貼回工作區、更新預覽，再測勾選、取消與重設。
再次按「下載這份 HTML」，把新版另存為departure-v2.html並保留首版；重開新版，確認第三項是「帶筆記本」且起始為0/3。
zh-Hant.expected: 你會得到一個可開啟的HTML檔：三項任務可勾選，完成數會跟著變，重設與重新開啟回到0/3。新版把「帶水壺」換成「帶筆記本」。配色和排版可以不同，重點是你真的能用。

independent.task: 新虛構清單：『讀書準備』，任務『選一篇文章』『記下三個問題』。自行寫需求請AI產生另一個不保存進度的HTML，保存study.html並測勾選、取消、重設及重開。
independent.expected: 初始0/2；兩項全勾2/2；取消一項1/2；重設0/2；重開0/2。需有自己的需求與實際產生檔，任務文字不得變成解說段落。

challenge.task: 加搜尋但不改變完成計數口徑。先貼上你已完成的完整HTML；尚未有檔案者先完成主練習。在同一AI對話確認目前完整版本，再貼下方新需求，不假設AI看得到本機檔案。
challenge.source: 虛構三項：下載車票、確認集合地點、帶筆記本。搜尋只影響顯示；計數仍統計全部三項；重設清除全部勾選及搜尋。
challenge.prompt: 在我的完整HTML加上文字搜尋，依來源規則；保留原功能與不保存進度。先列測試預期再提供完整檔案。
challenge.expected: 先勾下載車票與帶筆記本為2/3；搜尋『車票』只顯示一項，計數仍2/3；取消可見項後1/3；清除搜尋可看見帶筆記本仍勾選；重設後三項可見且0/3。

checks: 勾兩項顯示2/3，取消一項1/3，重設0/3。
重新開啟回到0/3；此練習不保存進度。
修改版只有第三項改成「帶筆記本」，計數仍正常；已保留首版，另存departure-v2.html並重開確認起始0/3。

quiz.question: 想把清單中的一項改掉，可以怎麼說？
choices: 只把「帶水壺」改成「帶筆記本」，其他功能保留，給我完整HTML
全部重做，不用說明想改什麼
只改畫面上看到的數字
quiz.explanation: 指出要改哪一處，AI比較容易保留你已經喜歡的其他部分。

zh-Hant.outcome:
文字示意：☑ 下載車票　☑ 確認集合地點　☐ 帶水壺
已完成2/3；取消一項變1/3，重設回0/3。
zh-Hant.why: 要出門清單、讀書清單或簡單活動工具時，可以先請 AI 做一個小版本。

en.title: Ask AI to make a clickable checklist
en.goal: Get a downloadable checklist webpage that opens, checks items, and resets.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source: Fictional checklist: title 'Before departure'; tasks in order: 'Download tickets', 'Confirm meeting location', 'Bring a water bottle'. No network or progress saving; reopening starts at 0/3.
en.prompt: Make a complete HTML checklist for these three tasks, with CSS and JavaScript in the same file and no external libraries or network. Each task can be checked. Show n/3 completed and a reset button. Support phones and keyboards. Do not save progress: reopening clears it to 0/3, and the page must say so. Give me the complete code without omissions.
steps: Paste the Practice material and Request for AI into your AI tool to get complete HTML code.
Copy the code into this page’s Complete HTML code field without the surrounding triple backticks. Select Update isolated preview.
In the preview, check two items, uncheck one, then reset. Counts should be 2/3, 1/3, and 0/3.
Select Download this HTML. Open the file from your browser downloads and check that reopening starts at 0/3.

In the same AI chat send: “Change only Bring a water bottle to Bring a notebook; give me complete updated HTML.” Paste the new code into the workspace, update the preview, and test checking, unchecking, and reset again.

Select Download this HTML again and save the new version as departure-v2.html, keeping the first version. Reopen the new file and confirm the third task is Bring a notebook and the initial count is 0/3.
en.expected: You get an HTML file that opens in your browser: three checkable tasks, a count that updates, and reset and reopening both return to 0/3. The new version replaces Bring a water bottle with Bring a notebook. Colors and layout may vary; what matters is that you can use it.

independent.task: New fictional checklist: 'Reading preparation', with 'Choose an article' and 'Write three questions'. Write your own request for another HTML file without progress saving, save study.html, and test checking, unchecking, reset, and reopening.
independent.expected: Initial 0/2; both checked 2/2; uncheck one 1/2; reset 0/2; reopen 0/2. Provide your own request and actual generated file. Task labels must not become explanatory paragraphs.

challenge.task: Add search without changing the counting scope. First paste your completed full HTML. If you do not have a file, complete the guided task first. Confirm the current complete version in the same AI chat before submitting the new requirement; do not assume AI can see your local file.
challenge.source: Three fictional tasks: Download tickets, Confirm meeting location, Bring a notebook. Search changes visibility only; the count includes all three tasks. Reset clears every checkbox and the search.
challenge.prompt: Add text search to my complete HTML using these rules. Preserve existing features and no progress saving. List test expectations first, then provide the complete file.
challenge.expected: Check Download tickets and Bring a notebook: 2/3. Search 'tickets': only one item is visible, count remains 2/3. Uncheck it: 1/3. Clear search: Bring a notebook is still checked. Reset: all three visible and 0/3.

checks: Check two for 2/3, uncheck one for 1/3, reset for 0/3.
Reopening starts at 0/3; this exercise does not save progress.
The revised version changes only the third task to Bring a notebook; counting still works. Keep the first version, save departure-v2.html separately, and reopen it to check the initial 0/3.

quiz.question: How can you request a change to one checklist item?
choices: Change only Bring a water bottle to Bring a notebook, keep the features, and give complete HTML
Redo everything without explaining what to change
Change only the number on screen
quiz.explanation: Naming the specific change helps AI keep the other parts you already like.

en.outcome:
Text illustration: ☑ Download tickets  ☑ Confirm meeting location  ☐ Bring a water bottle
2/3 completed; uncheck one for 1/3, reset for 0/3.
en.why: For packing, reading, or simple event tools, start by asking AI for a small working version.

zh-Hant.title: 網頁不對勁，怎麼請 AI 修好
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一份計數正確的修正版HTML，並保留可回頭使用的原檔。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構故障清單有三項：下載車票、確認集合地點、帶水壺。
故障檔：downloads/curriculum/broken-checklist-zh-Hant.html
可用對照檔：downloads/curriculum/correct-checklist-zh-Hant.html
已知問題：第一項有打勾，完成數卻沒有增加。
zh-Hant.prompt: 我會貼上故障HTML。只勾第一項時應顯示1/3，卻是0/3；勾前兩項應是2/3，卻是1/3。請找出原因，只修正計數問題，保留原有文字、重設與重開歸零。給我完整修正版，並簡短說明改了哪裡。
steps: 按「下載故障原檔」及「下載參考修正版」，保留兩份原檔。
用瀏覽器開故障檔，先勾第一項，再勾第二項：會看到錯誤的0/3、1/3。
按「複製故障程式碼與要求」，把完整故障HTML與修正要求直接貼到自己的AI並送出。
把AI修正後的完整HTML貼到本頁「完整 HTML 程式碼」，按「更新隔離預覽」。
試第一項單勾、前兩項、取消第一項、重設：應是1/3、2/3、1/3、0/3。按「下載這份 HTML」留下修正版。
另開保留的參考修正版，練習回到可用的版本。
zh-Hant.expected: 程式只從第二項開始數，所以漏掉第一項。修正應移除計數中的.slice(1)，讓全部核取方塊都列入。修好後：只勾第一項1/3，勾前兩項2/3，取消第一項1/3，重設0/3。不能一律加1，否則全部沒勾也會顯示1。

independent.task: 開啟獨立題虛構故障網頁，並下載downloads/curriculum/reset-bug-zh-Hant.html保留原檔。兩項讀書任務為「選文章」「寫三個問題」，起始0/2，勾兩項2/2；按重設後兩個勾都清掉，數字卻仍2/2。此指定檔確實定義updateCount()，但reset只清勾而未呼叫它。按這題的「複製故障程式碼與要求」，直接貼到自己的AI，補上你的重現報告並要求最小修正。把完整修正版貼回工作區測試，下載另存後重開再測；可下載correct-reset-zh-Hant.html對照，不套用到不明結構的其他程式。
independent.expected: 重現：重開→勾兩項→重設；預期未勾且0/2，實際未勾但2/2。清勾後加updateCount()；測2→重設0→再勾第一項1。不能只隱藏錯誤數字。

challenge.task: 開啟固定搜尋／重設故障網頁，下載search-reset-bug-zh-Hant.html保留原檔。先重現隱藏項未清除，再按這題的「複製故障程式碼與要求」直接貼到自己的AI，補上重現結果並要求最小修正。把完整修正版貼回工作區，下載另存副本，最後重開並依下方步驟回歸測試。
challenge.source: 虛構故障檔：downloads/curriculum/search-reset-bug-zh-Hant.html；對照檔：downloads/curriculum/correct-search-reset-zh-Hant.html。三項依序為下載車票、確認集合地點、帶水壺。計數應包含全部項目；搜尋只影響顯示；重設應清除所有勾選及搜尋。刻意錯誤：重設只清除目前可見項，隨後清搜尋，因此原先隱藏的勾選仍保留。
challenge.prompt: 我會貼上這份故障HTML。先說明並重現：勾第一與第三項為2/3；搜尋「車票」只見第一項但仍2/3；按重設預期全顯且0/3，實際全顯但1/3、第三項仍勾。請只修正reset，讓它遍歷所有核取方塊而非僅可見項，保留搜尋及計數範圍。回傳完整修正版與最小差異，列回歸步驟。
challenge.expected: 故障重現：勾1與3→2/3；搜車票→只1項可見、仍2/3；重設→全顯但1/3（第三仍勾）。修正後同樣操作，重設必須全顯且0/3，隱藏的第三項也已清除。再勾前兩項2/3→取消第一項1/3→重設0/3；搜尋仍只改顯示、不改計數範圍。修正只將reset清除範圍改為全部checkbox，不刪除第三項或硬把數字設0來掩蓋殘留勾選。保留原檔，需復原時重新開啟它。

checks: 第一項單獨勾選時顯示1/3，不再被漏掉。
勾前兩項2/3，取消第一項1/3，重設0/3。
不能一律加1；全部沒勾時必須是0/3。

quiz.question: 為什麼不能把故障計數一律加1？
choices: 全未勾會變1，掩蓋錯誤且製造新錯誤
quiz.explanation: 應修正被漏掉的計數範圍，不能用常數補償所有狀態。

zh-Hant.outcome:
修正前：只勾第一項，卻顯示0/3。
修正後：只勾第一項，正確顯示1/3。
zh-Hant.why: AI 做出的工具偶爾會出錯。說清楚「我做了什麼、發生什麼」，比較容易修到問題。

en.title: Something is wrong: ask AI to fix it
en.goal: Get corrected HTML with accurate counting while keeping the original file.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
The fictional checklist has three tasks: Download tickets, Confirm meeting location, Bring a water bottle.
Broken file: downloads/curriculum/broken-checklist-en.html
Working comparison: downloads/curriculum/correct-checklist-en.html
Known issue: checking the first item does not increase the completed count.
en.prompt: I will paste broken HTML. Checking only the first item should show 1/3 but shows 0/3; checking the first two should show 2/3 but shows 1/3. Find the cause and fix only the counting issue. Keep the text, reset, and zero-on-reopen behavior. Give complete corrected code and briefly explain the change.
steps: Select Download the original file and Download the reference fix. Keep both originals.
Open the broken file in a browser. Check the first item, then the second: it incorrectly shows 0/3 and 1/3.
Select Copy broken code and request. Paste the complete broken HTML and repair request directly into your AI tool and send them.
Paste AI’s complete corrected HTML into this page’s Complete HTML code field and select Update isolated preview.
Try the first item alone, the first two, unchecking the first, and reset: expect 1/3, 2/3, 1/3, and 0/3. Select Download this HTML to keep the fix.
Open the retained reference fix separately, practicing a return to a working version.
en.expected: The code starts counting from the second item, skipping the first. Remove .slice(1) from the counting expression so every checkbox is included. After repair: first item alone 1/3, first two 2/3, uncheck the first 1/3, reset 0/3. Always adding 1 would incorrectly show 1 when nothing is checked.

independent.task: Open the fictional independent-task bug webpage and download downloads/curriculum/reset-bug-en.html to keep the original. Its two reading tasks are Choose an article and Write three questions. It starts at 0/2; checking both gives 2/2. Reset clears the checks but still displays 2/2. This specific file defines updateCount(), but reset clears checks without calling it. Select this exercise’s Copy broken code and request button, paste directly into your AI tool, add your reproduction report, and request a minimal fix. Test the complete repaired HTML in the workspace, download it as a separate file, then reopen and retest. Download correct-reset-en.html for comparison; do not apply the change to unrelated code with an unknown structure.
independent.expected: Reproduce: reopen→check both→reset. Expected unchecked and 0/2; actual unchecked and 2/2. Call updateCount() after clearing checks. Test 2→reset 0→check first 1. Do not merely hide the incorrect number.

challenge.task: Open the prepared search/reset bug webpage and download search-reset-bug-en.html to preserve the original. Reproduce the uncleared hidden item. Select this exercise’s Copy broken code and request button, paste directly into your AI tool, add the observed result, and request a minimal fix. Paste the complete repaired HTML into the workspace, download a separate working copy, then reopen it and run the regression steps below.
challenge.source: Fictional bug file: downloads/curriculum/search-reset-bug-en.html; reference fix: downloads/curriculum/correct-search-reset-en.html. Tasks in order: Download tickets, Confirm meeting location, Bring a water bottle. The count includes all items; search changes visibility only; reset must clear every checkbox and search. Intentional bug: reset clears only currently visible items before clearing search, leaving hidden checked items checked.
challenge.prompt: I will paste this broken HTML. Explain and reproduce: check the first and third items for 2/3; search tickets so only the first is visible, still 2/3; reset should show all items at 0/3, but actually shows all at 1/3 with the third still checked. Fix only reset so it traverses all checkboxes rather than just visible ones. Preserve search and counting scope. Return the complete fixed file, minimal difference, and regression steps.
challenge.expected: Reproduction: check items 1 and 3→2/3; search tickets→one visible, still 2/3; reset→all visible but 1/3, with the third still checked. After the fix, the same sequence must reset to all visible and 0/3, clearing the hidden third item too. Then check the first two 2/3→uncheck first 1/3→reset 0/3. Search still changes only visibility, not counting scope. Change the reset clearing scope to all checkboxes; do not delete the third item or force the display to zero while leaving it checked. Preserve the original and reopen it if restoration is needed.

checks: The first item alone shows 1/3 and is no longer skipped.
First two checked: 2/3; uncheck the first: 1/3; reset: 0/3.
Do not always add 1; with nothing checked the count must be 0/3.

quiz.question: Why not add 1 to every faulty count?
choices: No checked items would show 1, masking the bug and creating another
quiz.explanation: Fix the omitted counting scope instead of applying a constant to every state.

en.outcome:
Before: checking only the first item incorrectly shows 0/3.
After: checking only the first item correctly shows 1/3.
en.why: AI-made tools can have bugs. Describing what you did and what happened makes repairs easier.

zh-Hant.title: 讓重複的事照規則做
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一張逐筆說明溫度規則結果的模擬表。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構溫度紀錄，只做文字模擬，不連接設備。
規則：溫度達28°C或以上，產生一筆「模擬空調啟動請求」並通知一次。低於28°C不動作；沒有溫度就先不動作。同一編號已處理過，就不要再做一次。
依序收到：E01：27°C；E02：28°C；E03：29°C；E04：沒有溫度；E02：28°C（同一筆重送）。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請依下方規則試算，每筆列溫度、是否產生模擬啟動請求、是否通知，以及一句原因。重送的同一筆不要重複處理。只做文字模擬。
steps: 把下方規則、五筆資料與要求一起貼到 AI，取得試跑表。
看28度與29度各有一次請求及通知；缺溫度的那筆先不動作。
接著送出：「改成超過28度才啟動，從空白紀錄重新跑這五筆。」看看28度那筆是否改為不啟動。
把兩版放一起看：第一次共2次，改後共1次。這裡試的是規則，沒有連接真實設備。
zh-Hant.expected: E01 27：不啟動，0請求0通知。E02 28：模擬啟動，1請求1通知。E03 29：模擬啟動，1請求1通知。E04缺值：未知，0請求0通知。重送E02：略過，0新增請求0新增通知。合計2請求2通知。>28的新批次僅E03啟動，合計1；還原>=28回到2。比較及去重是規則；AI可協助撰寫與解釋，未真正控制設備。

independent.task: 新虛構事件與規則：濕度>=70%發一筆除濕提醒（只模擬）；依ID去重，缺值記未知。依序H01,69；H02,70；H03,71；H04,缺值；H02,70重送。自行列逐筆結果。
independent.expected: H01不提醒；H02提醒1；H03提醒1；H04未知不提醒；重送H02略過。合計2筆提醒。70必須符合；缺值不是0%。

challenge.task: 寫清楚失敗重試與冷卻的狀態。
challenge.source: 虛構模擬，時間Asia/Taipei。規格：>=28產生請求；同ID最多嘗試2次（含首次）；僅成功後記已處理並通知；仍失敗交人工；通知成功後5分鐘內的其他事件可以有請求但不再通知。R1 10:00溫度28，首次失敗，10:01重試成功；R1 10:02重送；R2 10:03溫度29，成功；R3 10:07溫度28，兩次都失敗。
challenge.prompt: 只做狀態模擬，依序列嘗試次數、成功／失敗、去重與通知。不要真的重試任何外部服務。
challenge.expected: R1共2次嘗試，10:01成功並通知1；10:02重送略過。R2嘗試1次成功，但距上次通知2分鐘，冷卻中不通知。R3嘗試2次皆失敗，停止並交人工，未記成功、無成功通知。總嘗試5次、成功事件2個、通知1筆；不能無限重試。

checks: 達28度包含28；超過28度則不包含28。
缺少溫度不動作，同一編號重送不再通知。
這是文字模擬，沒有啟動真實空調。

quiz.question: 規格>=28°C，溫度缺值時應如何？
choices: 標示未知，不發控制請求
quiz.explanation: 缺值無法比較，不能偷偷轉成0或門檻值。

zh-Hant.outcome:
達28°C就啟動：共2次模擬請求。
改成超過28°C：共1次；重送不再觸發。
zh-Hant.why: 想讓系統自動提醒時，先把「什麼時候做、什麼時候不做」講清楚。

en.title: Let repeated tasks follow a rule
en.goal: Get a row-by-row simulation explaining the temperature rule.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional temperature readings for text simulation; no equipment connection.
Rule: at 28°C or above, create one simulated air-conditioner start request and one notification. Below 28°C, do nothing. With no temperature, do nothing for now. If an event ID has already been processed, do not process it again.
In order: E01: 27°C; E02: 28°C; E03: 29°C; E04: no temperature; E02: 28°C (the same event sent again).
en.prompt: Try the rules below. For each row show temperature, whether it produces a simulated start request, whether it notifies, and one reason. Do not process a repeated event twice. Use text simulation only.
steps: Paste the rules, five readings, and request into AI to get a trial table.
Check that 28 and 29 degrees each produce one request and notification; the missing reading produces no action.
Then send: “Change the rule to above 28 degrees and rerun these five events from an empty record.” See whether the 28-degree event stops triggering.
Compare the two versions: 2 requests first, then 1. This tests a rule; it does not connect to real equipment.
en.expected: E01 27: no activation, 0 requests/0 notifications. E02 28: simulated activation, 1/1. E03 29: simulated activation, 1/1. E04 missing: unknown, 0/0. Redelivered E02: skipped, 0 new requests/0 new notifications. Total 2 requests and 2 notifications. A fresh >28 batch activates only E03, total 1; restoring >=28 gives 2. Comparison and deduplication are rules; AI can help write and explain them. No actual device was controlled.

independent.task: New fictional rule and events: humidity >=70% produces one dehumidification reminder, simulation only; deduplicate by ID and mark missing as unknown. In order: H01,69; H02,70; H03,71; H04,missing; H02,70 redelivery. List each result independently.
independent.expected: H01 no reminder; H02 one; H03 one; H04 unknown, none; duplicate H02 skipped. Total 2 reminders. 70 qualifies; missing is not 0%.

challenge.task: Specify failure retries and cooldown state explicitly.
challenge.source: Fictional simulation, Asia/Taipei. Rules: >=28 creates a request; at most 2 attempts per ID including the first; only success marks the event processed and allows notification; persistent failure goes to a person. Other events within 5 minutes after a successful notification may create requests but no notification. R1 at 10:00, 28°C: first attempt fails, retry succeeds 10:01. R1 redelivered 10:02. R2 at 10:03, 29°C: succeeds. R3 at 10:07, 28°C: both attempts fail.
challenge.prompt: Simulate state only. List attempts, success/failure, deduplication, and notifications in order. Do not retry any external service.
challenge.expected: R1: 2 attempts, succeeds and notifies once at 10:01; redelivery 10:02 skipped. R2: 1 successful attempt, no notification because only 2 minutes have passed. R3: 2 failed attempts, then stop and refer to a person; no success state or success notification. Total 5 attempts, 2 successful events, 1 notification. No unlimited retries.

checks: At least 28 includes 28; above 28 does not.
Missing readings cause no action; repeated event IDs cause no new notification.
This is text simulation, not actual air-conditioner control.

quiz.question: Under >=28°C, what should happen when temperature is missing?
choices: Mark unknown and make no control request
quiz.explanation: Missing data cannot be compared and must not silently become zero or the threshold.

en.outcome:
At least 28°C: 2 simulated start requests.
Above 28°C: 1 request; repeated events do not trigger again.
en.why: Before automating a reminder, spell out when it should and should not happen.

zh-Hant.title: 把同一段話，說給不同的人聽
zh-Hant.goal: 得到中文與英文各一版短通知，並能調整成適合朋友的語氣。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source: 虛構通知L1：『雲岸共學』活動於2026/11/21 09:00（Asia/Taipei）在雲樓A室舉行；費用每人300 TWD；請於2026/11/18 18:00（Asia/Taipei）前回覆參加；午餐另計，價格未定。活動與場地無核准英文名稱。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請把下方資訊寫成中文與英文短通知，讓參加者快速看到時間、地點、費用與回覆期限。活動與場地名稱保留原文；午餐另計也要保留。
steps: 把活動資訊與要求一起貼到 AI，讀讀兩種語言的通知。
接著送出：「中文更像傳給朋友的訊息，英文再短一點。」
看看改寫後的日期與300 TWD／人有沒有變，午餐是否仍寫另計。
選出你喜歡的版本保存；遇到不懂的英文，可以追問「請用中文解釋這一句」。
zh-Hant.expected: 中文：『雲岸共學』11/21 09:00於雲樓A室舉行，每人300 TWD；請於11/18 18:00前回覆。日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei；午餐另計、價格待確認。英文：Join 雲岸共學 at 雲樓A室 on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), 300 TWD per person. Reply by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Lunch costs extra; the price is unconfirmed. 核對：兩版六欄一致，沒有新造官方名稱。

independent.task: 新虛構L2：2026/12/03 15:00（Asia/Taipei）『紙上散步』於B室；免費；12/01 12:00（Asia/Taipei）前登記；是否提供材料未知。無官方英文活動名。自行寫中英兩版及核對表。
independent.expected: 中文保留12/03 15:00、B室、免費、12/01 12:00登記期限、材料未知。英文可寫：紙上散步 is at Room B on 2026/12/03 at 15:00 (Asia/Taipei), free of charge. Register by 2026/12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials provision is unconfirmed. 不把免費延伸成含材料。

challenge.task: 把新通知改成兩句口語稿，仍保留限制。
challenge.source: 虛構L3：2026/12/10 19:00（Asia/Taipei）線上交流；12/08 17:00（Asia/Taipei）前報名；費用200 TWD／人；參加連結尚未提供。
challenge.prompt: 各寫中文與英文兩句口語稿。第一句活動與費用，第二句期限與未知連結，不能臆造URL。
challenge.expected: 中：12月10日19:00有線上交流，每人200 TWD。請於12月8日17:00前報名，參加連結待提供；以上日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei。英：The online exchange is on 2026/12/10 at 19:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 200 TWD per person. Register by 2026/12/08 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); the access link has not been provided. 可調整句型，但不能漏時區或填入虛構連結。

checks: 兩版活動日、回覆期限與300 TWD／人的金額一致。
午餐仍是另計、價格未定，不變成已含餐。
活動與場地名稱保留原文，完整通知保留Asia/Taipei時區。

quiz.question: L1英文版可以說午餐已包含嗎？
choices: 不行；來源說另計且價格未定
quiz.explanation: 改寫可以縮短措辭，不能更改包含範圍。

zh-Hant.outcome:
11/21 09:00一起參加「雲岸共學」，每人300 TWD。
Join 雲岸共學 on 11/21 at 09:00; 300 TWD per person.
（節錄；完整通知另含回覆期限與午餐說明）
zh-Hant.why: 通知太長、語氣太硬，或要傳給不同語言的朋友時，可以請 AI 換個說法。

en.title: Say the same thing for a different audience
en.goal: Get short Chinese and English notices and adjust their tone for friends.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source: Fictional notice L1: 雲岸共學 takes place on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 雲樓A室; 300 TWD per person. Reply whether attending by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Lunch costs extra; its price is undecided. Neither activity nor venue has an approved English name.
en.prompt: Write short Chinese and English notices from these details. Make the time, place, price, and reply deadline easy to find. Keep activity and venue names in their original form and keep the extra lunch cost.
steps: Paste the activity details and request into AI and read both notices.
Then send: “Make the Chinese sound like a message to a friend, and make the English shorter.”
Check that the dates and 300 TWD per person did not change, and lunch still costs extra.
Save the versions you like. For unfamiliar English, ask: “Explain this sentence in Chinese.”
en.expected: Chinese: 『雲岸共學』11/21 09:00於雲樓A室舉行，每人300 TWD；請於11/18 18:00前回覆。日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei；午餐另計、價格待確認。 English: Join 雲岸共學 at 雲樓A室 on 2026/11/21 at 09:00 (Asia/Taipei), 300 TWD per person. Reply by 2026/11/18 18:00 (Asia/Taipei). Lunch costs extra; the price is unconfirmed. All six fields agree, with no invented official names.

independent.task: New fictional L2: 紙上散步 at Room B on 2026/12/03 15:00 (Asia/Taipei); free; register by 12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei); materials provision unknown. No official English activity name. Write both language versions and a fact comparison independently.
independent.expected: Chinese preserves 12/03 15:00, B室, free admission, 12/01 12:00 registration deadline, and unknown materials. English example: 紙上散步 is at Room B on 2026/12/03 at 15:00 (Asia/Taipei), free of charge. Register by 2026/12/01 12:00 (Asia/Taipei). Materials provision is unconfirmed. Free admission does not imply included materials.

challenge.task: Make a two-sentence spoken script while retaining limitations.
challenge.source: Fictional L3: online exchange 2026/12/10 19:00 (Asia/Taipei); register by 12/08 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); 200 TWD per person; access link not yet provided.
challenge.prompt: Write two sentences each in Chinese and English: activity and price first, then deadline and missing link. Do not invent a URL.
challenge.expected: Chinese: 12月10日19:00有線上交流，每人200 TWD。請於12月8日17:00前報名，參加連結待提供；以上日期皆2026年，時間皆Asia/Taipei。 English: The online exchange is on 2026/12/10 at 19:00 (Asia/Taipei), at 200 TWD per person. Register by 2026/12/08 17:00 (Asia/Taipei); the access link has not been provided. Wording can vary; time zone and missing-link status cannot be dropped.

checks: Both versions keep the same activity date, reply deadline, and 300 TWD per-person price.
Lunch remains extra with its price unconfirmed, not included.
Keep original activity and venue names and Asia/Taipei in the full notice.

quiz.question: May L1's English version say lunch is included?
choices: No; the source says extra cost with price undecided
Yes, because there is an admission fee
quiz.explanation: Rewriting may shorten wording but cannot change what is included.

en.outcome:
11/21 09:00一起參加「雲岸共學」，每人300 TWD。
Join 雲岸共學 on 11/21 at 09:00; 300 TWD per person.
(Excerpt; the full notice also includes the reply deadline and lunch details.)
en.why: When a notice is too long, too formal, or needs another language, ask AI to change how it is written.

zh-Hant.title: 做一個你下週就用得到的小作品
zh-Hant.goal: 得到一份自己的生活小作品，例如購物清單加準備順序。
zh-Hant.quick: 先試下方的小任務；已經熟悉的話，可以直接換題練習。
zh-Hant.skip: 依自己的進度，選擇跟著做、換題練習或進一步挑戰。
zh-Hant.source:
虛構範例：週六四人一起在家吃晚餐。
希望18:30開飯，準備番茄義大利麵、沙拉與水果。
家裡已有義大利麵和橄欖油；其他食材要買。
需求：幫我做購物清單與簡單準備順序，不用計算預算。
zh-Hant.prompt: 請用下方需求與資料，做一份簡單可用的第一版。先用文字清單呈現，不用做網站。完成後問我最想調整哪一處。
steps: 想一件下週會做的事：準備聚餐、整理書單、安排練習都可以；也可以直接用下方範例。
把需求與資料一起貼到 AI，取得第一版。
看完後改一處，例如增加人數、換成表格、縮短成手機容易看的版本。
拿成品走一遍實際情境：照著它準備時，還少哪一項？請 AI 補好，再存到你找得到的地方。
zh-Hant.expected: 第一版可以分成「要買」與「怎麼準備」。要買：番茄、沙拉蔬菜、水果及建議配料；已有的義大利麵和橄欖油另列。準備順序可以先洗切蔬果，再煮醬、煮麵，最後拌沙拉。AI補充的份量是建議，你可依食量調整。

independent.task: 換成你自己的小需求，例如一週讀書安排或出門準備。先給三項必要資訊，請AI做第一版，再改一個條件。不要貼私人或機密資料。
independent.expected: 沒有唯一答案。你能說出它幫你省掉哪一步，並照著成品完成一次小操作，就有了可以繼續改善的起點。

challenge.task: 讓別人也能使用你的成品。
challenge.source: 沿用你剛做的作品；如果用晚餐範例，新增條件：改成六人，其中一人不吃乳製品。
challenge.prompt: 請依新條件更新我的作品，先列這次改了什麼，再給完整新版。補一段給第一次使用的人看的簡短說明。
challenge.expected: 晚餐範例需調整六人份建議，乳製品另外提供或改用不含乳製品的配料。保留原版，請同伴讀新版說明，看看能否自己開始；有卡住的地方就再改。

checks: 成品有直接可用的內容，不只是教你如何規劃。
已有的義大利麵與橄欖油，不必重複列為必買。
新增條件後，相關項目跟著改；AI建議份量可依需求調整。

quiz.question: 怎樣的題目適合當第一個小作品？
choices: 我下週會用到，而且能先做出一個簡單版本
必須一次做完整套大型系統
一定得從指定品牌或專案選一個
quiz.explanation: 從熟悉、範圍小的需求開始，比較容易試用，也比較知道下一步想改什麼。

zh-Hant.outcome:
週六晚餐｜要買：番茄、沙拉蔬菜、水果。
先洗切蔬果 → 煮醬與麵 → 拌沙拉，18:30開飯。
zh-Hant.why: 把前面學到的提問、修改與試用，用在你真的想省時間的小事情上。

en.title: Make something you can use next week
en.goal: Get a small piece of work for your own life, such as a shopping list and preparation order.
en.quick: Try the task below first. If you already know how, move on to an independent practice.
en.skip: Choose the guided steps, a new practice, or a deeper challenge at your own pace.
en.source:
Fictional example: four people having dinner at home on Saturday.
Aim to eat at 18:30. Make tomato pasta, salad, and fruit.
Pasta and olive oil are already at home; other ingredients need buying.
Need: a shopping list and a simple preparation order. No budget calculation needed.
en.prompt: Use the needs and data below to make a simple, usable first version as a text checklist. No website needed. Then ask what I most want to adjust.
steps: Choose something you will do next week: prepare a meal with friends, organize books, or plan practice. You can also use the sample below.
Paste your need and data into AI to get a first version.
Change one thing after reading it: add people, use a table, or make it shorter for a phone.
Walk through the real situation with your result. What is still missing? Ask AI to improve it and save it somewhere you can find again.
en.expected: A first version can have “Buy” and “Prepare” sections. Buy tomatoes, salad vegetables, fruit, and suggested extras; list the pasta and olive oil separately as already available. Wash and chop produce, prepare sauce, cook pasta, then mix the salad. Any quantities added by AI are suggestions you can adjust to appetites.

independent.task: Use your own small need, such as a weekly reading plan or a packing list. Provide three necessary details, ask AI for a first version, then change one condition. Do not paste private or confidential information.
independent.expected: There is no single correct answer. If you can explain which step it saves and use it for one small action, you have a useful starting point.

challenge.task: Make your result easy for someone else to use.
challenge.source: Use the work you just made. For the dinner example, change to six people, including one who avoids dairy.
challenge.prompt: Update my work for this new condition. Say what changed, then give the complete new version. Add a short explanation for a first-time user.
challenge.expected: For dinner, adjust suggested quantities for six and offer dairy separately or use dairy-free alternatives. Keep the original. Ask a companion to read the new instructions and try starting; improve any confusing parts.

checks: The result contains usable content, not only advice on how to plan.
Pasta and olive oil are already available; they need not be listed as required purchases.
Relevant details change with new conditions; adjust AI-suggested quantities to your needs.

quiz.question: What makes a good first small project?
choices: Something I will use next week and can start with a simple version
It must be a complete large system
It must come from a fixed brand or project
quiz.explanation: A small, familiar need is easier to try out and gives you a clearer idea of what to improve next.

en.outcome:
Saturday dinner | Buy tomatoes, salad vegetables, and fruit.
Wash and chop → prepare sauce and pasta → mix salad; eat at 18:30.
en.why: Use asking, revising, and trying things out on a task where you actually want to save time.
